status.see_doctor_today: Please speak with a clinician today.

reason.readings_in_expected_ranges: No warning indicators were flagged in these simulated readings.
reason.abnormal_reading: One or more readings are outside the placeholder range. Check again and contact your clinician if you are concerned.
reason.high_wound_ph: The wound pH reading is above the placeholder range. Please speak with a clinician today.
reason.sensor_dropout: A sensor reading is missing. Check the patch and ask for help if the problem continues.
reason.red_flag: A warning sign was reported. Please speak with a clinician today.

offlineBody: The app could not reach the readings service. No local or real readings were substituted.
scenariosHint: These values are simulated. They do not describe a real wound.
scenarioError: The demo reading could not be changed. Please try again.
invalidPhone: Enter a phone number with at least 3 digits.
callUnavailable: Calls are not available on this device.
shareDisclaimer: Proof of concept. Simulated data only; not a diagnosis or medical advice.
disclaimer: Proof of concept — not a medical device and not a diagnosis.
thresholdNote: Safety ranges are placeholders and need clinician review.
speakUnavailable: Read-aloud is not available right now.
apolloGreeting: Hello. Ask me about your wound. Answers come only from trusted health websites, and every answer shows where it came from.
apolloError: Apollo could not answer right now. Please try again.
aboutTinyFish: TinyFish fetches live guidance from trusted health websites.
aboutDocker: Docker packages our backend so it runs the same everywhere.
activityHint: Only general health topics are sent. Your name, phone, readings and documents are never sent.
chipPus: There is pus or a smell
historySubtitle: Every reading is stored in the database, so a clinician can see the whole course.
historyStored: Stored in PostgreSQL. When run with Docker Compose, a Docker volume keeps it between restarts.
historyError: History is not available right now.
trendHint: A small model trained on synthetic data estimates whether pH may cross the doctor line soon. It never changes your status.
trendWatch: Worth watching: readings are moving toward the doctor line.
trendRising: Readings are rising quickly toward the doctor line.
findCareHint: Type your area. A TinyFish browser agent will look it up on a map. Only the area you type is sent.
findCareArea: Area or city, e.g. Dwarka, Delhi
findCareWorking: The TinyFish agent is browsing the map. This can take up to a minute.
findCareSource: Found by a TinyFish browser agent from Google Maps. Please call to confirm.
findCareCached: Saved result from an earlier search
findCareNone: No places were found. Try a nearby area.
careErrNoKey: Browser lookup isn't set up yet (TinyFish key missing).
careErrCredits: TinyFish has run out of credits.
careErrTimeout: The lookup took too long. Try again.
careErrOther: Couldn't look this up right now.
careErrArea: Please type an area or city (3 to 60 characters).
